kind_of_thing.quote: A metro station or subway station is a train station for a rapid transit system, which as a whole is usually called a "metro" or "subway".

kind_of_made_thing.why: A metro station is a place where people go to buy tickets and board trains, so it is a building.

what_people_do_there.quote: A station provides a means for passengers to purchase tickets, board trains, and evacuate the system in the case of an emergency.

read_by.rule: every value carries a sentence found word for word in the saved page
